purpose: Measure whether fixed geometry-v2 review rules separate updated generated images from real images without fitting a threshold or changing origin scoring.

implementation.threshold_source: existing controlled-fixture review threshold; not fitted on OpenFake or FiveK

views: in-memory JPEG-85 re-encode of the same decoded image

fixed_rules.any_check: at least one available G1-G4 anomaly score is at least 0.5
fixed_rules.two_or_more_checks: at least two available G1-G4 anomaly scores are at least 0.5
fixed_rules.nonrepeat_any: at least one available G1, G2 or G4 anomaly score is at least 0.5
fixed_rules.g3_supported: G3 is at least 0.5 and at least one available G1, G2 or G4 score is at least 0.5

required_reports: measurement status, applicability and elapsed time by view and label
per-check availability, score mean and candidate prevalence by label and model
each fixed rule's generated-image hit rate and real-image review burden with Wilson 95 percent intervals
each fixed rule by generator and real-source slice
both-view, original-only, JPEG-85-only and neither-view identities by label
sampled process working-set peak and active 512 MiB fail-closed limit

interpretation.candidate_means: registered geometry pattern requiring review, not proof of AI generation
interpretation.comparison_use: identify whether G3-only review burden dominates and define what must be tested on a new holdout before any geometry score proposal
